title: All Good Reunions Follow a Search
description: After some searching, you and Paimon arrive at the location indicated by the picture...

mainQuestExcel.title: All Good Reunions Follow a Search
mainQuestExcel.description: After some searching, you and Paimon arrive at the location indicated by the picture...

dialogs.text: This should be the place from the picture. Look, Ororon and Ifa are here!
Hello!
Ah, now that sounds like a happy Paimon. Great! No need to be on guard then.
Please, even an "angry Paimon" is harmless.
Ugh! Watch it, buddy!
All you gotta do is give her a treat.
Hey! Paimon's not Cacucu! You can't just give her a cracker and call it a day...! Okay, maybe that would help...
But, y'know what? It doesn't matter! Paimon's in a good mood today, and you're not gonna tease her out of it!
Hold on, speaking of Cacucu... Where is he? Don't tell Paimon the Capybara King gobbled him up?
What? Do you even hear yourself, bro?
Cacucu has joined hands with the enemy to bully us.
Bully you? Cacucu? Hahaha, good one, Ororon...
That wasn't meant to be a joke.
Huh?
Then, this so-called "enemy" is...?
He said his name was "Cacasha."
Wait, so does that mean he's an Asha? An Asha that can talk?
Whoa, hold up. Ororon is... embellishing. Let me explain.
Cacucu is, uh... playing hide-and-seek around here with an Asha.
And by that, we mean that they're allied against us.
Cacucu is fast, and Cacasha can disguise himself... So, we face a crafty enemy indeed.
We played round after round with the little guys before you showed up.
And, listen, Cacucu is a beast at this game. Am I proud of him? Yeah. But man, I am getting worn out...
It's your own fault for not going to Coach Iansan's fitness class.
*sigh* Seriously, having to search up and down for these little guys, round after round... My back's killing me!
Of course it is. Because you didn't go to Coach Iansan's fitness class.
...Alright, alright. I get the picture! I'll go when we get back. Happy?
Hey, shouldn't you do a little more seeking right about now? Who's gonna track down Cacucu and Cacasha if you keep bickering like this?
Ah, well, that brings us to the perfectly good lemon that just fell right into our lap...
Me... again?
Mm-hmm.
Fine. I'll go.
#You got this, {M#Gramps}{F#other Granny}! Oh, and you too, Granny Paimon!
Just have fun, and call us if you need help.
Wait, I thought we were gonna be Ashas as well?
Oh no... Please don't tell Paimon you're gonna hide with them and force us to find you too?
That's right! From now on, I'm "Orasha," and he's "Ifasha." Gotta go hide. Good luck!
Bro! What the...! Gah...
Sorry, guys. Mind humoring him for a bit?
Not at all. It's fun!
Thanks, you two! Guess that means I should get hiding!
Don't worry! I have more than enough energy to spare!

flow.stepDescription: Play a thrilling game of hide-and-seek

dialogs.text: *sigh*... We did it, finally! That was too much work.
Oh, you must be Cacasha! You and Cacucu make a really impressive duo! And, as part of a formidable duo herself, Paimon would know!
Impressive, bro!
See what I mean? When those two join forces, it's almost impossible to beat them.
Cacucu, I can officially say you've earned your certificate in the "art of concealment." From now on, you can call yourself a master trickster.
Oh, wow! You're the best, bro!
Hey, what about me? I was the one who played with you the most!
You're awesome, too, bro!
Huh... I think he has something to give us...
Cacasha presents a Gift Egg to the group...
Oh! Another Gift Egg, and another picture too. I think I've seen this symbol around the Easybreeze Market...
Bro... Why does it feel like we've got another challenge coming our way...?
Huh? Is this some kind of secret treasure hunt, hidden around the resort? I have to see it through!
See it through, bro!
Seems like Cacucu is having a blast.
#Well, you can't have an adventure without {NICKNAME} and Paimon! Whaddaya say, wanna check it out?
Definitely! Let's see it through!
Alright, guess I'm along for the ride, then.
Found it! We were right about the Easybreeze Market!
Easybreeze Market!!
Chill, bro. I know you're excited, but we've gotta get the lay of the land first.
Ahem... Step on up, dear patrons! Pick an egg, any egg! Let this be your lucky day!
Test 'em out free of charge! What do you say?
Oh, so this is where the picture was leading us. This must be where the Gift Eggs come from.
Well, hehe... Let's see how far that lucky streak gets us!
S—Step right up! The gift eggs are all set for the picking!
Hmm...
You first.
Seriously, bro? Don't tell me you actually buy into the whole "bad luck to go first" thing? ...Fine, fine. Have it your way.
By the luck of the Asha, gimme something good!
Whoa, Saurus Crackers! Score!
Oh...
Pff...
You don't like Saurus Crackers, Ifa?
Oh, don't get me wrong, we both love 'em. But, when it comes to Gift Eggs, they're not exactly one of the better prizes.
Whatever, anything that tastes good is fine by me. Here, everyone can have some.
Make fun of me all you want, bro. Just wait until you get one of those weird Magma Eggs, and see if I help you then!
Impossible. You can never resist helping people.
Now... Is there a special ritual I should do before opening the egg?
Whatever you think will bring you good luck, I guess.
Got it. "Flower-Feather Clan Patrol Team — open up!"
Whoa, it's the Flower-Feather Clan specialty, "Sing Your Heart Out"... Guess that ritual actually worked...
Nice! I'll take anything but Mystique Soup, honestly. I'm so tired of that stuff...
Guess I lucked out with this huge tub of candy! Dig in, everyone!
You're the best, bro!
After making a meal of the Saurus Crackers, Cacucu crunches away at the candy.
All the sugar gives everyone a bit of a rush...
Paimon's turn, Paimon's turn! Ooh, what should she say for good luck... Ah, got it!
Ahem... "Gotta be the big one! C'mon, big yummy, big yummy!"
Hehe... Oh! It's the soup Ororon didn't want...
Nice one, Paimon! Something you can keep all for yourself!
Huh, good point. All the more for Paimon, then! Hehe, time to dig in...
Ah, so sweet and refreshing! Perfect for the season!
Alright, that leaves you two... Who wants to go next?
No rush, bro!
I'll go first, then.
Go for it, Traveler! Oh, and don't forget to think of something lucky to say!
(Something lucky, huh...)
(deep inhale...)
Benny's Adventure Team, assemble!
Glittering Gemstones... Wow, something sweet again!
Hehe, takes me back to when I took in my protege...
#Seems like {M#Gramps}{F#other Granny} is lost in some beautiful memories. Guess it was a lucky draw, then...
Alright, Cacucu, you're up. Show 'em what you got!
Hahaha... Go for the win, bro! Or just... do better than Ifa, at least.
Yeah, yeah, whatever you say.
Let's go, bro! "Nice to meet you, bro!"
Whoa... What is that!?
Score! Score!
Well, would you look at that!
Ahem... Aaand we have a winner! Congratulations to Mr. Cacucu for becoming the third patron of the day to win our grand prize!
In addition to these Mini Asha Pockets — our most exclusive prize — we're pleased to award Mr. Cacucu with a serving of every dish available from our gift eggs!
Seriously, bro!?
Yeah, seriously, bro!? Who would've thought Cacucu would turn out to be the lucky one...
Haha, congrats, bro!
Cacucu, my good bro... Ah, no, my good sir, I have a humble request.
They say that luck can be passed around by shaking hands. Would you mind if I...
Haha! Sure thing, bro!
Everyone follows Ororon's lead and shakes Cacucu's wing.
It's an infectious feeling. Soon, everyone is petting his head too.
It's so perfectly round and soft. You almost don't want the moment to end.
Hehe, that should be enough to give Paimon good luck for the rest of the year...
You can count on that, Paimon. Because you have a very special companion in your life. Just like Cacucu does...
Wh—What are you looking at me for...?
Well, this was your plan all along, wasn't it? Time to come clean, don't you think?
Uh, what are you talking about?
Wait, so Cacucu's luck...
Okay, okay. It's no big deal, alright? Of course the little guy's lucky to have a bro like me.
Stop dodging the question and give it to us straight. You set all this up, didn't you? The fishing, the hide-and-seek, everything...
Well...
That must mean you knew that adventurer from Mondstadt already.
No, not really. I met him a day before you did, that's all, and asked him to point me in the right direction.
And, yeah, I organized everything with the pictures so that Cacucu could play with the Asha and capybaras. And I set up the gift egg thing, too.
Oh wow, bro...
Haha... But, the Capybara King kinda took it the wrong way. At the end of the day, a wild animal's not gonna understand everything you tell them.
My guess is that he thought we were trying to steal the things I prepared for Cacucu, and that's why he was upset.
Oh, so he's actually called the Capybara King.
Of course not. Just thought I'd use the name you gave him.
Oh wow, bro! I'm touched.
...So, now you know! It just happened to be around the anniversary of when I met Cacucu, and I wanted to do something special for him.
We don't know when Cacucu's actual birthday is, so we've always just used the anniversary as an excuse to celebrate it.
Cacucu might act like a mature, big brother type of saurian. But, deep down, he's just a little guy who likes to play.
I know you're just a little guy inside and out, buddy. So, have as much fun as you want, okay?
Bro, bro...
Oh, did you have something to add, Cacucu?
Bro, it's not...
Bro, you don't have to say it. I understand. We love you, too.
Yeah, don't be embarrassed, bro. While we're here at the resort, you're as free as a wild qucusaur. All you need to do is have fun.
Happy anniversary, Cacucu!
Bro! Bro!
Was all because of...
We should save the best for last.
Well, are you happy, buddy? Did you have fun?
Oh wow, bro!
I think that's a yes. Happy birthday, bro.
Oh, and that reminds me. Why didn't you tell me about the plan, bro? Seriously, bro, bros don't hide things from other bros, bro.
Haha... To be honest, I wanted to see if you remembered the anniversary.
Psh... You've changed, Ifa. How am I supposed to trust you when you betray a bro like that?
Heh... Well, jokes on you, because I did remember. I saved some fresh honey for Cacucu. I know the price of forgetting the anniversary, and I wasn't about to get pecked in the head for a whole year.
Wouldn't do that, bro! You're the best!
Hello again, bro!
Earlier, I was trying to tell Ifa that he got the date wrong.
But, I stopped myself. I guess part of being mature is knowing when it's better to let things go.
